_readme: SOURCE OF TRUTH for The Glizzness menu. Edit this file, never site/our-menu.html.
python gen_menu.py --write    -> regenerates the website menu from this file
python push_menu.py --apply   -> pushes names/descriptions/prices to Square (-> DoorDash)
square_id fields let the push UPDATE existing Square objects instead of creating duplicates.
website:false hides an item from the site (still sold on the cart / in Square).
"retired": true marks an item to remove from Square on the next push.
